title: Custom eggless birthday cakes — pickup before school drop-off in Rouse Hill
summary:
Riverstone opens at 6am on weekdays. Not an accident — it's for parents doing a cake pickup on the way to school drop-off in Rouse Hill or Stanhope Gardens.

Every cake here is 100% eggless. Not some cakes. Every cake, every time, which is why Jain and halal-observant families order without asking first. Six sizes, 15 flavours including Rasmalai and Mango, buttercream, fondant, or ganache, any design from a photo reference.

48 hours minimum notice. That's what fresh baking actually takes. Free parking at Riverstone Shopping Centre — no circling the block with a cake box balanced on your knee.

Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725.
